description: Returns a paginated list of coins ordered by `rank` ascending (top-ranked first). Pass the `tracked` filter only when you need to limit results by editorial coverage.

q.description: Free-text search across name + symbol. Case-insensitive substring match.

tracked.description: Filter by editorial coverage. Omit to return both tracked and untracked coins; set `true` for actively monitored coins only; set `false` for coins outside active coverage only.

name: list_coins
title: List coins
